'''Borleias Control''' was the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] military command during the [[Battle of Borleias (Yuuzhan Vong War; Second)|Battle of Borleias]]. It was located in the former [[Alderaan Biotics]] facility on [[Borleias/Legends|Borleias]].
